entries.message: Feature - Expand media discovery and personal media workflows
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Add Up Next and Discover rails for richer movie and TV discovery.
Add watchlist, ratings, and custom-list actions across media detail pages.
Group Force sync, info, image editing, match fixing, and deletion under a persistent Tools section.
Improve artwork fetching, media cards, and detail-page behavior across screen sizes.
Add personal-media APIs, database migrations, and artwork persistence for movies and TV shows.
Keep legacy database upgrades idempotent as the personal-media schema evolves.
